**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **Direction check:** The only MFN-style language in the agreement is Section 6 (within the COMPENSATION section, ¶p0047), where **TrueLink** promises that Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," plus a one-year price freeze. That MFN benefits us as Client.
- **No burden on us:** I searched the compensation, license, and Client covenant/warranty provisions for reciprocal or Customer-side MFN language ("most favored," "no less favorable," third-party matching, exclusivity) and found none. Section 8 grants TrueLink only a non-exclusive license to Client Data — not a best-terms obligation.
- **Result:** Preferred position is already met (no MFN obligation on Customer, and a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour). Per the redline guidance, the Vendor-granted MFN is preserved untouched.
